name: shell_exec
title: Remote Shell
description: Execute a shell command on the selected HHC client. Fallback tool: prefer dedicated HHC filesystem, process, service, log, browser and system tools whenever they can perform the requested operation. High-risk operation: executes arbitrary commands on the host. client_id and command are mandatory; commands run bounded with timeouts and truncated output. User confirmation is recommended before execution.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

cwd.description: Optional absolute working directory. When omitted, HHC uses the target host canonical runtime root.
